Thorny Path. A shortcut, they said.
Thorns? The legion fears no thorns! ...Ouch.
exact.O dikenleri ben ektim. Sulamayı da unutm: I planted those thorns. And I never forget to water them.
Frog Island. The very heart of the marsh.
exact.Çamur, kurbağa, sivrisinek... Arenayı öz: Mud, frogs, mosquitoes... I miss the arena.
exact.Kurbağalar benim dostum. Seni çok sevece: The frogs are my friends. They'll love you. As dinner.
exact.Fener Bekçisinin Mezarı. Bekçi hâlâ nöbe: The Lamplighter's Grave. The keeper is still on watch.
exact.Fener sönük. Gölgeler bana yol gösterece: The lamp is out. The shadows will guide me.
exact.Bekçi fenerini sana tutacak. Biraz yakın: The keeper will hold his lamp up to you. Rather close.
Reedy Shore. The shallow end of the Black Lake.
exact.Atlar suya girmez mi? Girecekler!: Horses won't go in the water? They will!
exact.Bubu sabahtan beri aç. Tam vaktinde geld: Bubu's been hungry since morning. Perfect timing.
Bone Bridge. The last crossing to the chapel.
exact.Bu köprü kemikten mi? Benim zırhım daha: A bridge of bones? My armor is sturdier.
exact.Köprüyü eski misafirlerimden yaptım. Sen: I built this bridge from old guests. You'd make a lovely railing.
Hunters' Camp. The traps are set.
exact.Kemik kokusu! Tuzakları kontrol edin!: The smell of bones! Check the traps!
exact.Tuzaklarına iskelet koydum. Yanlış taraf: I put skeletons in their traps. Let them catch the wrong end.
Plague Ditch. Nobody wants to go in.
exact.Kutsal su her şeyi temizler. Hendeği bil: Holy water cleans everything. Even the ditch!
exact.O hendeği yüz yıldır temizletmiyorum. Bı: I haven't had that ditch cleaned in a hundred years. Leave it be.
exact.Mum Işığı Koridoru. Batık manastırın kal: Candlelit Corridor. The heart of the sunken monastery.
exact.Mumlar yandıkça karanlık geri çekilir!: As long as the candles burn, the dark retreats!
exact.Mumlar erir. Ben kalırım. Basit matemati: Candles melt. I stay. Simple math.
exact.Kemik Mahzeni. Katedralin altında, kemik: Bone Vault. Shelves of bone beneath the cathedral.
We'll interrogate these bones. All of them.
My bones don't talk. But they bite.
Crimson Rampart. The last wall before the Moon Altar.
exact.Duvar düşerse arkasında ben varım. Ve ço: If the wall falls, I'm behind it. And very angry.
